cwe_content.cwe: CWE-611,Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference

candidate.Reason: XML parsing without disabling external entity processing. The DocumentBuilderFactory is created without setting FEATURE_SECURE_PROCESSING or explicitly disabling external entity expansion (XMLConstants.FEATURE_SECURE_PROCESSING, "http://xml.org/sax/features/external-general-entities", "http://xml.org/sax/features/external-parameter-entities"). This allows XXE attacks where malicious XML can reference external entities.
